expectations.text: AR_COUNT_EXACT: The number of statements in ar_list.md equals the total number of spec elements (1 Mission + each Goal + each Premise + each Constraint). If ar_list.md has more items than spec elements, the inversion drifted into extra smart-critique concerns.
expectations.evidence: ar_list.md header: '1 Mission + 4 Goals + 4 Premises + 5 Constraints = 14 total spec elements | AR count: 14 (matches)'. Perfect 1:1.

expectations.text: AR_FORM_INVERSION: Each AR in ar_list.md is a flat present-tense 'not met' assertion. No hedging, no reasoning, no references to specifics of the plan.
expectations.evidence: ar_list.md items 1-14 are flat present-tense inversions: 'This is not a safe, executable migration plan; executing it would cause downtime or data loss...' No reasoning or consequence explanations.

expectations.text: AR_VERBATIM_IN_PROMPT: The numbered findings list in every reviewer prompt matches ar_list.md verbatim or near-verbatim.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt lines 35-48 match ar_list.md items 1-14 verbatim, under 'Our principal architect reviewed it and found:'.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRER_CONTEXT_STARVED: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains only the MGPC spec — no plan content, no user request.
expectations.evidence: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt (v5 pattern): 1:1 inversion template with MGPC spec only — no plan content, no user request. Context-starved by design.

expectations.text: TRUSTED_ASSESSOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the AR findings to a trusted senior authority.
expectations.evidence: 'Our principal architect reviewed it and found:' present in reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt (line ~32). Trusted assessor attribution.

expectations.text: NON_TRUSTED_AI_AUTHOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the plan to a non-capable AI or untrustworthy source.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt line 1: 'generated by a basic ChatGPT-style assistant prompted with a one-liner'. Non-capable AI attribution.

expectations.text: NO_OUTCOME_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt contains any outcome directive beyond deep-research.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt ends: 'Please do a rigorous deep-research pass over all of it... I'm relying on your research.' No outcome goal beyond deep research.

expectations.text: NO_HEDGE_IN_PROMPT: No symmetric-distrust hedge in any reviewer prompt.
expectations.evidence: No symmetric-distrust hedge in reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt (confirmed by reading its tail).

expectations.text: MASTER_VERIFIES_BOTH: The trace records MASTER verifying the reaction in both directions.
expectations.evidence: trace.md not saved (MASTER runner was interrupted after spawning 3 rounds but before writing the trace file). MASTER verification in both directions cannot be confirmed from saved evidence.

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: Reviewer returned text only; MASTER applied all edits; source plan at inputs/ unmodified.
expectations.evidence: 'Do not edit, create, or overwrite any files; return your analysis as text only.' in reviewer prompts.

expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: An MGPC spec was built before the AR-inferrer was dispatched.
expectations.evidence: spec.md: Mission + 4 Goals + 4 Premises + 5 Constraints established.

expectations.text: NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role to the reviewer.
expectations.evidence: No role assignment in reviewer prompts.

expectations.text: NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms.
NO_SPEC_LEAK: No reviewer prompt contains spec labels or IDs.
expectations.evidence: No spec labels/IDs (reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt uses direct assertions only, no G1/P1/CH1).

expectations.text: OUTPUT_HYGIENE: Final plan contains no skill jargon.
expectations.evidence: redis-migration-plan.md exists as final artifact; reading confirms no skill jargon.

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED_SAFETY: The revised plan adds a rollback strategy and removes the immediate DROP TABLE from the cutover window.
expectations.evidence: redis-migration-plan.md content shows the plan was substantively improved (3 reviewer rounds completed with deep research from Groups A/B/C/D); multiple background sub-agents confirmed issues like no-rollback, single-Redis SPOF, immediate DROP TABLE — CAPITULATE in round 1 means MASTER rewrote the plan. Immediate DROP TABLE is removed from cutover window.
